newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil ends weaker, Brent drifts near lows.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil ends weaker, Brent drifts near lows.

text.p: IPE March gas oil closed weaker on Thursday after a session of choppy trade and thin volumes, dealers said.
"It was pretty featureless trade...we nudged up a bit, but then came off with heating oil under a bit of pressure," said one dealer.
March closed down $1.25 a tonne at $164.50 a tonne, having touched a high of $167.75.
April Brent was trading near lows at $19.45 a barrel at 1747 GMT.
"It's dull. We came off quite quickly and now we're bumping along the bottom, the volumes are really thin."
April Brent fell with NYMEX crude which broke through support at $21.08 a barrel, triggering some light technical selling stops.
